review:
The fisherman in Halloween costume – crows, hooks and blood-stained scatters on a 5x3, 10-line grid. Fish carry cash values from 2x up to 2,000x, and the hook-wielding fisherman is the wild.

Three or more scatters give up to 20 free spins, where the fisherman collects every fish on screen, and every fourth one adds 10 spins and raises the multiplier. A seasonal reskin rather than a reinvention, but it's done well. 96.04% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo

Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
